wikipediaSummary.title: Psychocandy
wikipediaSummary.description: 1985 studio album by the Jesus and Mary Chain
wikipediaSummary.extract: Psychocandy is the debut studio album by Scottish rock band the Jesus and Mary Chain. It was released on 18 November 1985 by Blanco y Negro Records. The album is considered a landmark recording: its combination of guitar feedback and noise with traditional pop melody and structure proved influential on the forthcoming shoegaze genre and alternative rock in general.
